description: Returns `false` to skip `render` for this update. A performance hint; a wrong comparison causes stale UI.
A `Component` with a built-in shallow comparison of props and state. The class counterpart of `memo`.
Static method run before every render that returns a state patch or `null`. Use it only to reset state when a prop changes; prefer a `key`.
Reads the DOM right before it changes (for example scroll position) and passes the value to `componentDidUpdate` as `snapshot`. No hook equivalent.
`UNSAFE_componentWillMount`, `UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps`, `UNSAFE_componentWillUpdate`: render-phase methods that break with concurrent rendering.
